name: catenin alpha 1

function.text: CTNNA1 encodes catenin alpha-1. Annotated molecular activities include structural molecule activity and beta-catenin binding. It participates in axon regeneration and cell adhesion.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to CTNNA1-related diffuse gastric and lobular breast cancer syndrome (autosomal dominant); hereditary macular dystrophy (autosomal dominant). Additional curated associations are listed below.

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.
